headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on Auto Recycling Systems IPO
sum: Auto Recycling Systems Limited (ARS) has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME platform for a book-built offer for an entirely fresh issue of 69,00,000 shares, with an offer size of ₹72.26 crore+. Legacy…
detail: Auto Recycling Systems Limited (ARS) has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME platform for a book-built offer for an entirely fresh issue of 69,00,000 shares, with an offer size of ₹72.26 crore+. Legacy Law Offices Auto Recycling Systems as well as the Book Running Lead Manager, Finaax Capital Private Limited, on this SME IPO. The transaction team comprised of Naman Anand (Counsel), Yash Dogra (Senior Associate), and Associate Anushka Indurkar. Surbhi Narang (Partner) provided strategic inputs.
